title: Researcher in Philosophy of Science
about: Researcher position in philosophy of science at the Department of Philosophy, Stockholm University. The aggregator describes a project spanning philosophy of experiment, social epistemology and the history and philosophy of post-war cosmology and related fields.
card_alt: Card for the Researcher in Philosophy of Science at Stockholm University, Department of Philosophy, Stockholm, Sweden, deadline 8 Nov 2026. The photo shows an aerial view of Stockholm's old town, Gamla Stan and Riddarholmen, by the water.
